svg.text: STAND-ALONE KEYER - sheet 1/2: power, PIC, paddle, key out, controls (draft 1, 2026-11-05)
Q1: reverse-battery protection (body diode, then the FET turns on).
VSENSE = VBAT x 0.32 (9.5 V -> 3.0 V; LB 6.5 V; stop 5.8 V).
KEY OUT - isolated (modern rigs: 60 V / 100 mA)
Tip = key, ring = PTT / amp, sleeve = common.
KEY_COM is NOT connected to the keyer GND.
Tip = dit, ring = dah (swapped by the reverse setting).
Q2: LM386 power, off while the keyer is idle (AMP_EN low = on).
STAND-ALONE KEYER - sheet 2/2: sidetone, LM386, audio switch (draft 1, 2026-11-05)
SIDETONE (as Rev 2 sheet 2; LM386 on switched 5 V)
AUDIO SWITCH: sidetone or rig audio to the phones
U8 is normally closed: rig audio passes with its LED off (no current).
Firmware (stand-alone): RX_CW high = rig audio on, low = muted while sending.
